crossRefs.note: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock shall be there in the cities of Gilead;

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

translations.web: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock shall be there in the cities of Gilead;
translations.bsb: Our children, our wives, our livestock, and all our animals will remain here in the cities of Gilead.
translations.kjv: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead:
translations.asv: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead;
